license_note: The BAAI/bge-m3 model card declares license mit in its frontmatter and the repository metadata carries the same MIT tag; the repository ships no LICENSE file of its own, so the grant is the standard MIT text. No separate model-use terms were found on the pages read.

license_evidence.scope: BGE-M3 weights published in BAAI's Hugging Face repository under the MIT licence declared by the model card

access_boundary: This record represents the BGE-M3 embedding checkpoint. The BGE rerankers, the bge-large/bge-base/bge-small line, the multilingual-Gemma BGE releases, and the FlagEmbedding toolkit repository are separate boundaries.
strengths: One checkpoint serves dense, sparse, and multi-vector retrieval across more than one hundred languages with 8,192-token context
Permissive MIT grant declared both in the model card and the repository metadata, with weights in PyTorch and ONNX formats
tradeoffs: No developer API or managed host serves this checkpoint, so running it is entirely self-operated
The repository carries no versioned release beyond the single checkpoint, so line updates arrive as new repositories rather than revisions

evidence.label: BAAI BGE-M3 weight repository: MIT licence, multilingual embedding
BGE documentation: BGE is developed by the Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence
